slides.texte_overlay:
How to plan a road trip
you'll never forget
Choose a route, not just a destination. Small roads, coastal drives, mountain passes. The best moments usually happen between the places you planned.
Plan only half the trip. Book a few nights, leave the rest open. Freedom to stay longer somewhere special is what makes road trips magical.
Pick the right people. Two or three friends who stay calm when plans change. The company matters more than the car or the views.
Make a great playlist together. Everyone adds ten songs. Music turns long drives into some of the best memories of the trip.
Learn the stories of the places you'll see. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes every stop more interesting.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes every stop more interesting.

slides.texte_overlay: Stop where the locals stop. Small cafés, markets, hidden beaches. Ask people for their favourite place nearby and go there.
Take photos, but put the phone away often. Some of the best moments are the ones you just watch, without trying to capture them.
